summary.value: Use `Tag` to display categories or statuses.

a11y.method: drafted from the docs page, quote-verified, NOT yet human-reviewed

value.rule: Group multiple Tags in a list so assistive tech announces them as a list, not one sentence
value.quote: If you are displaying several Tag components together, we recommend using a <ul> list with one <li> per Tag . This ensures that they are announced as a list rather than as one continuous sentence, providing a better experience for users of assistive technologies.

value.rule: Place multiple tags in a <ul>/<li> structure so screen readers announce them as a list
value.quote: When using multiple tags together, place them in a <ul> with <li> elements so screen readers announce them as a list.
